# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156 release strengthens native-platform support, fixes data and text handling, and modernizes Uno and WebAssembly integrations. It raises Apple deployment baselines, moves Uno views to Uno Platform 7, and incorporates targeted m156 engine fixes. Review the migration guidance before upgrading platform-specific applications.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple platform minimums are higher** — Native macOS now requires 11.0, while iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst require 14.0. Update application deployment targets before consuming the new native assets. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI now targets Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10. Upgrade Uno applications and use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on non-Windows Uno targets; SKSwapChainPanel uses a CPU fallback there. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **SKData.CreateCopy validates requested array length** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now rejects a length beyond the source array with ArgumentOutOfRangeException. Pass a length within the supplied array rather than relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **WebGPU consumers need rebuilt WebAssembly native archives** — WebGPU support now compiles emdawnwebgpu C++ code into libSkiaSharp.a. Rebuild custom or cached WebAssembly archives before linking .NET 8 and later WebGPU applications. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **m156 upstream rendering fixes integrated** — Updates the bundled renderer with fixes for invalid runtime-effect types, raster-pipeline overflow handling, and BGRA uploads on GLES. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Native builds use a current GN generator** — Updates GN for the native build while retaining SkiaSharp's established generated-header and include behavior. ([#5420](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5420))

## API Surface

- **String character-code conversion is corrected** — Character-code APIs now decode exactly one unit for the selected text encoding, and byte-array string conversion consistently reports null arguments. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows the display clock** — Continuous GL texture rendering is paced by Android display callbacks instead of swap throughput, while explicit rendering requests remain responsive. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Managed image and text paths reduce allocations** — Managed pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 input, and native feature-string handling avoid unnecessary temporary allocations without changing results. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams retain their backing data** — Fixes stream ownership so front-buffered data remains available for its intended lifetime. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Linux HarfBuzz keeps its bundled implementation isolated** — Bundled HarfBuzz function calls are bound locally on Linux, preventing conflicts with a system HarfBuzz library loaded by another component such as GTK. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Platform

- **Uno views move to Uno Platform 7** — The Uno views package adopts Uno 7's unified renderer and .NET 10 baseline while preserving CPU rendering where non-Windows targets have no swap chain. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Windows native components use updated platform dependencies** — WinUI, MAUI, Uno, and ANGLE build paths align on current Windows App SDK, WebView2, Visual Studio, and Windows SDK dependencies. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
- **WebAssembly WebGPU linking is simplified** — The WebGPU C++ support is included in the SkiaSharp static archive while required JavaScript glue remains a consumer link input. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
